sentences.en: Cindy dozed off in the middle of her graduation examinations.
sentences.zh: 辛迪在她的毕业考试中间打瞌睡了。

sentences.en: I wired him a message of congratulation on his graduation.
sentences.zh: 我在他毕业后给他发了一份祝贺电报。

sentences.en: She got married soon after her graduation from the college.
sentences.zh: 她从大学毕业不久就结婚了。

senses.zh: 毕业；毕业典礼；刻度，分度；分等级
